title: Bing Chilling
blurb: John Cena, in Mandarin, holding an ice cream, promoting a Fast and Furious film with more sincerity than the situation could possibly require. The clip resurfaced in 2021 and the internet adopted it wholesale, largely on the strength of the delivery. Very good, very nice — committed enough that it loops back around to genuinely charming. It works as a greeting or a non-sequitur. It also works as a way to derail any conversation that has turned too serious. Bing chilling is simply the Mandarin for ice cream, and somehow that is the least interesting part.
origin: John Cena's viral Mandarin ice cream video.
